dual-anchoring-escaped-pipe-in-dispositi.purpose: A `Disposition` carrying an escaped `\|`, so the row splits into nine cells against an eight-cell header. `Class` keeps its left-hand header index and still reads `amended`; `Commit` is anchored at `-2` from the row's end and still reads `a1b2c3d`. A left-anchored `Commit` read takes the disposition's second half instead, finds no matching record, and returns `undeterminable` — which leaves a genuinely stale page set unregenerated. That is the silent, wrong-direction failure this case exists to catch.
